seo.title: Orifice Plate Flow Calculator - ISO 5167
seo.description: Orifice Plate Flow Calculator — Calculate flow rate through an orifice plate using ISO 5167 differential pressure method with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.explanation: Q = Cd × A_orifice × √(2ΔP/(ρ(1−β⁴))) where β = d/D. Engine converts mm→m and kPa→Pa. ×3600 to m³/h.

content.introduction: Calculate flow through a sharp-edged orifice plate per ISO 5167. Uses the discharge coefficient method where β = d/D and Cd ≈ 0.6 for thin-plate sharp-edged orifices at Reynolds numbers above 10,000.

example.description: 50mm orifice in 100mm pipe (β=0.5) at 10 kPa ΔP, Cd=0.6: ~20 m³/h water flow.

faq.a: ISO 5167 recommends β = 0.2-0.75. β = 0.4-0.6 gives best accuracy with acceptable pressure loss.

faq.q: What permanent pressure loss does an orifice cause?
faq.a: Permanent loss ≈ (1−β²) × ΔP ≈ 60-90% of measured differential. This is the main drawback vs venturi (10-20% loss).
